# Vendored data: Hanna & Ameisen, model-planning-public

- Source repository: https://github.com/hannamw/model-planning-public
- Commit: `993cff51450f43e8e86c254f761cc48c008b8dab`
- Paper: Hanna & Ameisen, "Latent Planning Emerges with Scale" (ICLR 2026).
- License: MIT (see `LICENSE`, copied unchanged from the source repository).

Only the files this project's experiments read are included, at their original
relative paths and unmodified. `SHA256SUMS` lists their checksums; verify with
`shasum -a 256 -c SHA256SUMS` from this folder. To refresh or extend the copy,
check out the same commit of the source repository and copy additional files
at their original paths, then regenerate `SHA256SUMS`.
